entities.summary: Scott Adam Rice is an American former professional baseball pitcher. A first-round draft pick in the 1999 MLB draft, his career was slowed by injuries. He pitched in minor league baseball for 14 seasons before his first promotion to Major League Baseball (MLB) in 2013, with the New York Mets.
